runs.description: A dark comedy packed with sparkling wit and language that dissects and illuminates the complex marriage of George and Martha. Two couples engage in psychological games over one intense evening, blurring the boundaries between reality and illusion until the games transform them all.

When a deputy mayor's wife goes missing following a mysterious accident, arriving dinner party guests become entangled in a web of confusion, miscommunication, and lies spun to conceal the truth from each other — and from a pair of increasingly suspicious police officers.

Shakespeare's wittiest comedy centers on Beatrice and Benedick — two characters so renowned for their sparring that audiences watch breathlessly as sharp-tongued antagonism slowly, inevitably, turns to love.

Dark, bloody, brutal, and magnificent. Driven by witches' prophecies and their own ambition, the Macbeths murder their way to Scotland's throne — only to find that power brings nothing but paranoia, guilt, and the fracturing of the very bond that made them dangerous.

August Wilson's Fences follows Troy Maxson — Shakespearean in scope, a wordsmith and brilliant storyteller — who has built a stable life while carrying the weight of unfulfilled dreams. Blending myth and intimacy, the play explores the walls we build to protect the people we love, and the ones that keep them out.

Brad and Janet, a wholesome young couple, find themselves stranded by a thunderstorm and stumble into the castle of Dr. Frank 'N' Furter, an eccentric alien scientist mid-experiment. A hilarious, wild ride through B-movie science fiction and horror, with an infectious rock score that audiences know by heart.

Based on John Waters' cult 1990 film, this rockabilly musical follows Wade "Cry-Baby" Walker — a charismatic delinquent — and Allison, a girl from the right side of the tracks who falls for him anyway. Their forbidden romance ignites a battle between the squares and the drapes in 1950s Baltimore.

Tom Stoppard's absurdist masterpiece puts two minor characters from *Hamlet* center stage, watching the tragedy unfold from the wings while wrestling with questions of fate, free will, and what it means to be a supporting character in someone else's story.
Contemporary political satire blended with random jaunts into the deranged psyche of homo sapiens, with live music woven throughout. A sketch comedy benefit for Indivisible Santa Cruz County.
A musical conceived and written by Capitola songwriter Joe Ortiz, making its Actors' Theatre debut after years of workshops and readings since its world premiere at Cabrillo Stage in 2012.

Nightclub singer Deloris takes refuge in a convent and unexpectedly transforms its struggling choir into a sensation. An energetic celebration of sisterhood that blends humor and heart, as the sisters find their voices — and each other.

Santa Cruz's beloved annual festival of world-premiere ten-minute plays, billed as the longest-running short play festival in the world. Scripts are selected through an international competition and performed for the first time on any stage.
Staged readings of the runners up from this years 8 x 10s Festival submissions.

A powerful one-person play exploring the life and genius of Vincent van Gogh through the eyes of his brother Theo, drawing on their extensive correspondence. Projections of Van Gogh's own paintings illuminate a solo performance that reaches past the stereotypes to reveal the man behind the art.

On their separate honeymoons, recently divorced exes Amanda and Elyot discover they are staying in adjoining hotel rooms. Noël Coward's sparkling comedy of bad manners follows two people who are perfectly wrong for each other — and completely unable to stay apart.

runs.show: The Last Five Years (Jason Robert Brown)
runs.description: Jason Robert Brown's musical tells the story of a relationship from both ends simultaneously — Cathy's journey moves backward through the years while Jamie's moves forward. Through beautiful music and moving lyrics, the show looks deeply at the sacrifices we make, how we come to define each other, and what it costs to let go.

Dickens' beloved tale returns as a theatrical and music-filled family tradition in the heart of Santa Cruz. A night of ghostly visits transforms the miserly Ebenezer Scrooge — and reminds audiences what the season is really about.

The once prosperous town is dying. Percy, a convicted murderer on parole, ends up lodging with Hannah, the longtime owner of The Spitfire Grill. Together they discover that hope and community are worth fighting for, in this musical about redemption and revival.
An exciting weekend of a reading of a new play by a local playwright!

A coming-of-age story about a young Jewish girl cast as Jesus in her school's Christmas pageant in 1930s Brooklyn. By turns funny and touching, the play explores cultural identity, family traditions, and what it truly means to belong — while celebrating the richness of difference.

Agnes Evans discovers her deceased sister Tilly was passionate about Dungeons & Dragons and enlists a dungeon master to navigate Tilly's fantasy world. A surprisingly sweet tale that blends action, wit, and emotional depth — celebrating gaming culture while exploring grief and the bonds between sisters.

Inspired by the 1936 anti-drug propaganda film, this musical comedy sends clean-cut protagonists spiraling into jazz-fueled chaos with deliberately over-the-top production numbers. Campy, wickedly funny, and sharp as satire, it mixes Broadway-style numbers with swing, Vegas flair, and an angelic chorus.

Four eccentric Broadway stars descend on a small town when a teenage girl wants to bring her girlfriend to prom and faces community resistance. This Drama Desk Award-winning musical blends laugh-out-loud humor with a timely message about love, inclusion, and the unexpected places solidarity can come from.

runs.show: The Whole Monkey Show (Christopher Michael Palermo)
runs.description: Writer and performer Christopher Michael Palermo presents stories and fractured essays from his unique perspective on the world as it is, was, and has always been.
A playful, "what-if" spoof imagining Matt Damon and Ben Affleck struggling to write their cinematic masterpiece after a magical script literally falls from the ceiling of their apartment.
